description: This file contains the implementation of the DittoProtocolSub interface, handling pub/sub interactions for live signals and twin events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages subscriptions, unsubscriptions, and acknowledgement labels for streaming types related to device communication.

classes.name: DittoProtocolSubImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DittoProtocolSub interface managing pub/sub interactions for streaming types and acknowledgements.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DittoProtocolSubImpl using the provided ActorContext.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to specified streaming types and topics with a given ActorRef, managing filter and acknowledgement logic.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from both live signal and twin event subscriptions.

methods.name: updateLiveSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates subscriptions for live signals based on new streaming types and topics.

methods.name: removeTwinSubscriber
methods.description: Unsubscribes a twin event subscriber from specified topics.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgement labels for a subscriber, ensuring they are fully resolved before declaration.

methods.name: ensureAcknowledgementLabelsAreFullyResolved
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgement labels are fully resolved, throws exception if not.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement label declarations for a subscriber.
